book.title: 潮汐为什么会涨落
book.subtitle: 月亮、太阳与旋转的海岸
book.question: 潮汐为什么会涨落？

moral.zh: 月球和太阳的引力、地球自转以及海岸地形共同影响潮汐。
moral.en: The Moon, Sun, Earth’s rotation, and the shape of a coast all influence the tides.

pages.zhText: 清晨的沙滩上，小雨用贝壳画下水线：“妈妈，海水怎么退远了？”
pages.enText: On the beach that morning, Xiaoyu marked the waterline with a shell. “Mom, why has the sea moved farther away?”

pages.zhText: 傍晚再来，水线又靠近了。小雨抱住妈妈：潮汐为什么会涨落？
pages.enText: When they returned in the evening, the waterline was closer again. Xiaoyu hugged Mom. “Why do the tides rise and fall?”

pages.zhText: 妈妈说：月球的引力遍及地球，近处和远处受力略不同，海水因此形成两处隆起。
pages.enText: Mom explained, “The Moon’s gravity reaches across Earth. It pulls a little differently at different places, making two broad ocean bulges.”

pages.zhText: 一处隆起朝着月球，另一处在背向月球的一边；不是只吸起正下方的海水。
pages.enText: One bulge faces the Moon, and the other is on the far side of Earth. The Moon is not simply lifting water right below itself.

pages.zhText: 太阳也有引力。月球、太阳和地球排成一线时，潮差常较大；方向成直角时，潮差常较小。
pages.enText: The Sun has gravity too. When the Sun, Moon, and Earth line up, the difference between high and low tide is often larger. At a right angle, it is often smaller.

pages.zhText: 地球自转，让海岸轮流经过高低潮；海岸形状和水深也会改变潮汐。
pages.enText: As Earth spins, coasts pass through high and low tides. Coastline shape and water depth also change each tide.

pages.zhText: 下午水线果然远了。小雨说：“月球、太阳、自转和海岸都在影响潮汐！”
pages.enText: That afternoon the waterline was farther out. “The Moon, Sun, Earth’s spin, and the coast all shape the tides!” said Xiaoyu.
